verdict.rationale: React lets you add components to existing HTML pages incrementally (react-docs-1, react-gh-3), but it introduces new concepts like JSX (a non-standard syntax extension, react-docs-2), component/state model, and internal reconciliation that go beyond plain HTML/CSS/JS. Community evidence even notes React's internals are 'very challenging' to understand (react-comm-7), undercutting the 'minimal new concepts' claim.
